name: Beim Mini am Tennsee
kurzbeschreibung: **At the Mini at Tennsee in Tirol** – where tiny cars meet alpine charm! Discover the world’s only **Mini** theme park nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** countryside, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Here, you can explore a whimsical village of **Mini** cars, enjoy a delicious **Kaiserschmarrn** at the cozy café, and take in breathtaking views of the **Tennsee** and surrounding mountains. A perfect day out for families and car enthusiasts alike!
